1:1.text: the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

1:3.text: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

1:4.text: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

1:5.text: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

1:6.text: Guide us to the straight path -

1:7.text: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned
anger or of those who are astray.
